questions.question: At Boland Park, Paarl, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Chantelle van Schoor holds it with 13.

questions.question: At Potchefstroom Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Badgers or Kei?
At which ground did Iinyathi record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Khaya Majola Oval — largest win by runs of 262, against Kei on 2015/02/21.

questions.question: "Warriors" is the current name for which former provincial union?
At which ground did Zenande Nonqayi record their career-best innings (55, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Buffalo Park, against Iinyathi on 2024/03/16.
